Chapter 1209: Chapter 23: Third Realm, The Heavenly Pillar Descending from the Sky (Please Subscribe)_2

That is Lin Yuan, although he has not followed the path of Chaos Rule evolution, his foundation in other aspects is so strong that it compensates for the gap in Chaos Rule evolution power with the other Great Saint Venerables.

...

The Third Realm of Chaos Rule, in addition to significantly accelerating the evolution of the Chaotic Taiji Dao.

It also has a profound impact in other areas, such as the time to step into the Chaos Realm. Currently, what restrains Lin Yuan from breaking through to the Chaos Realm is that all aspects have not yet reached their limit.

Like the breakthrough of the flesh, the universe within the Soul Body, and so on.

And as Chaos nurtures all things, the Chaos Rule of the Third Realm allows Lin Yuan to improve rapidly in all aspects.

In addition, it also helps in the cultivation of the third layer of "Infinite Void," as higher-level insights into Chaos Rule of the basic cosmic structure become easier and more relaxed.

...

In the source world, within the treasure land.

Lin Yuan’s true self did not search for the central core pillars of the treasure land.

In the span of a thousand years, seventy to eighty Peak Venerable-level powerhouses from six major ancient countries continuously searched, and have basically already refined the core pillars.

The current ranking of core pillar refinement for each major ancient country is as follows—

Da Fu Ancient Country: 72 pillars.

Barbaric Wilderness Country: 54 pillars.

Fierce Sun Ancient Country: 52 pillars.

Da Ling Ancient Country: 45 pillars.

Thunderclap Ancient Country: 38 pillars.

Xuanyin Ancient Country: 38 pillars.

...

The ranking for refining core pillars among the ancient countries, with Da Fu Ancient Country, indisputably in first place.

This did not come as a surprise to the numerous Peak Venerables since with Fu Xu Venerable of Da Fu Ancient Country making a move, the top Peak Venerables from other ancient countries would generally yield.

Even though these top Peak Venerables carry their respective ancient country’s trump cards, they won’t use them lightly.

"This Barbaric Wilderness Country..."

Lin Yuan’s expression displayed slight surprise, as the Peak Venerables of Barbaric Wilderness Country were utterly desperate in competing for the core pillars, to the point that the Red Flame Venerable had to repeatedly give up the discovered core pillars.

The top Peak Venerables of Barbaric Wilderness Country only retreat slightly when they encounter Fu Xu Venerable.

But when facing the top Peak Venerables of other ancient countries? They have a do-or-die attitude.

"However, this first-class treasure land, the number of core pillars actually exceeds three hundred?"

Lin Yuan’s expression became slightly solemn, based on previously learned information, the usual number of core pillars for first-class treasure lands is about one hundred to two hundred.

Three hundred?

Very rare, among the currently known first-class treasure lands, only six had core numbers surpassing three hundred when they first emerged.

"Three hundred core pillars... there should also be giant core pillars completely integrated into space-time within this treasure land."

Lin Yuan thought to himself, deducing this conclusion from those six treasure lands, each had a giant treasure land core appear at that time.

A giant treasure land core far surpasses regular ones, equivalent to ten ordinary treasure land cores.

But unlike ordinary ones, a giant core completely melds with the time-space of the treasure land, impossible to detect no matter how it’s searched, only appearing after all cores have been refined.

The emergence of a giant core makes quite a commotion, affecting the entire treasure land.

"The importance of a giant core cannot be understated; it’s not just equivalent to ten ordinary cores, but it’s also easier to guard."

Lin Yuan thought to himself, currently, each major ancient country holds tens of treasure land core pillars, but there are only twelve Peak Venerables. How are twelve Peak Venerables supposed to defend dozens of core pillars?

Although a Venerable can instantly arrive beside a refined core pillar, if many of them are simultaneously attacked, which one to choose for descent?

And the giant core pillar, once refined, allows guarding ten core pillars with the difficulty of defending just one.

"Based on the experience from the previous six treasure lands, the giant core could appear anywhere in the treasure land, in the central area? Or the border area? Both are possible."

Lin Yuan silently pondered, simultaneously focusing on sensing the space-time fluctuations around him.

Once a giant core pillar emerges, the phenomenon it causes cannot be concealed, allowing one to reach it promptly if detected.

Fierce Sun Nation Capital, within an isolated space.

"The likelihood of my Fierce Sun Ancient Country refining the first giant core pillar is low."

The Red Flame Venerable spoke calmly, "So there’s no need to pay much attention."

His words were met with little rebuttal from the other Peak Venerables.

Firstly, due to the vastness of space-time within the treasure land, the giant core pillar might appear anywhere.

Considering travel speed, among the seventy to eighty Peak Venerables from the six major ancient countries, none can surpass Da Fu Ancient Country’s Fu Xu Venerable.

Over a thousand years, Fu Xu Venerable has demonstrated his expertise in space-time, able to traverse from one end of the treasure land to the other in a single breath.

In other words, once a giant core pillar appears, Fu Xu Venerable can descend in just one breath.

This terrifying speed is unmatched by any top Peak Venerable, and if Fu Xu Venerable is the first to refine a giant core pillar, other countries stand little chance.

"Our aim is the second and third giant core pillars."

The Red Flame Venerable stated.

Normally, a treasure land birthing more than three hundred cores will have three giant cores.

The previous six treasure lands each had three giant treasure land cores.

Given Fu Xu Venerable’s strength, claiming the first giant core is without difficulty, but attempting to take the second? That would be challenging.

Should Fu Xu Venerable vie for the second giant core, the first one he holds would inevitably face attacks from top Peak Venerables of other ancient countries.

"Understood."

Lin Yuan nodded.

Thus far, within this treasure land, Fu Xu Venerable’s strength remains indisputably paramount.

In fact, beyond just this treasure land, throughout the history of the six major ancient countries, among the beings below the founders, Fu Xu Venerable is considered among the most powerful few.

So the first giant core pillar has already been tacitly conceded to Fu Xu Venerable by the Red Flame Venerable.

...

In the treasure land, Lin Yuan idly hid within a valley meditating.

Since the Red Flame Venerable, leader of Fierce Sun Ancient Country’s treasure land campaign, has relinquished the contention for the first giant core pillar, Lin Yuan would naturally comply.

Moreover, Lin Yuan found the reasoning of the Red Flame Venerable quite sound—there’s no need to stubbornly contend with Fu Xu Venerate. With time only halfway through and not yet at the height of competition, waiting a little longer could be wise.

Time slowly drifts by.

Then one day.

The space-time within the treasure land quivered slightly.

A strange wave swiftly swept across all directions.

"This aura, has the giant core pillar emerged?"

The presence of this strange wave immediately stirred the Peak Venerables, stemming from the treasure land itself rather than from the clashes of the strong. In the current state, only the emergence of a giant core pillar could cause such a disturbance.

"Humph!"

"Countries like Fierce Sun, Thunderclap, and Xuanyin have abandoned the fight for the first giant core pillar, but as for my Thunderclap Ancient Country, we must make a try. What of Fu Xu Venerable’s strength?"

A figure composed entirely of thunder flipped a hand, revealing a heart formed purely of the Power of Space-Time. With every beat, it aroused threads of space-time force.

"Go."

This thunder figure urged the space-time heart, tearing through layers of space-time, heading toward the place where the giant core pillar emerged.

"Giant core pillar? It might yet belong to my Da Ling Ancient Country."

Spirit Prison Venerable’s gaze turned profound. At that moment, both his eyes shimmered deep within. Upon sensing the strange wave, his figure disappeared without a trace.

Simultaneously.

The multitude of Peak Venerables likewise rushed toward the location of the giant core pillar, even if they don’t plan to compete, they wish to watch from afar. After all, Fu Xu Venerable will surely make a move.

...

"This?"

Lin Yuan also perceived this peculiar wave. Compared to the strength of other ancient countries, his perception of the oddity is more intense and clearer, as if right before his eyes.

Indeed, it was like that.

The location where the giant core pillar arose was right beside him, only a few hundred meters away, almost adjacent.
